research_question: Resolve whether Japan's SBIC refers to one company or a regional group, identify the legal entities and determine whether any direct XRP/Circle/Coinbase relationship is established.
conclusion: The SBIC identity should be represented as a three-company regional network of separate sister corporations established under the same Japanese statute in November 1963, not as one nationwide legal entity and not as SBI Holdings.

historical_and_operating_context.initial_structure: Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka companies were established separately within five days of one another in November 1963 under the same law.
historical_and_operating_context.privatization: Tokyo SBIC's official history says the three companies were initially special corporations and became special private corporations after the July 1986 legal reform; their policy-implementation role continued.
historical_and_operating_context.business_model: Regional investment and growth-support institutions: equity subscriptions, subscription rights/convertible bonds, capitalization support, business succession, management advice, human-resource development and business matching.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Japan's SBIC is one nationwide legal company.
competing_hypotheses.evidence_against: Three distinct official company profiles, separate corporate names, separate establishment dates and separate regional headquarters; each identifies sister companies.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBIC is a three-company regional network created under one national statute.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Official company profiles and history identify Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka as separately incorporated sister companies established November 15, 18 and 20, 1963.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The SBIC companies are SBI Holdings group companies.
competing_hypotheses.evidence_against: Their legal names, statutory basis, corporate profiles and sister-company descriptions are distinct; no ownership or group relationship to SBI Holdings is established.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBIC training events establish a commercial OpenAI partnership or XRP relationship.
competing_hypotheses.evidence_against: The events are educational programmes for investee companies, sometimes delivered by third-party speakers; no commercial partnership, token investment, XRP integration or XRPL project is stated.

feature_admission.sbic_identity: Represent as three separate regional legal entities with a shared statutory origin and sibling relationships.
feature_admission.sbic_chatgpt: Training/seminar event records only; not partnership or platform integration.
feature_admission.sbic_xrp_relationship: NOT_ADMITTED absent direct contract, investment, product, custody, payment or official partnership evidence.
feature_admission.sbi_group_relationship: Do not merge SBIC with SBI Holdings, SBI VC Trade or Circle SBI Japan K.K.

forecast.reason: SBIC identity and training activity have no validated causal connection to XRP market outcomes.

next_actions: Keep Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka SBIC as separate entities in the relationship graph.
